subject.title: [do not merge] refactor: flip sessions and transcripts to sqlite storage

question: Should the SQLite cutover also change deleted/reset archive retention to keep indefinitely by default and enforce a default 2 GB per-agent session-artifact budget?
rationale: Those defaults change existing users' deletion, retention, disk-consumption, and upgrade behavior; the SQLite cutover does not technically require that product policy to change in the same release.

options.title: Split retention policy
options.body: Preserve the currently shipped retention and disk-budget defaults in this PR, then review the keep-by-default cold-tier policy separately with focused upgrade evidence.

options.title: Approve combined policy
options.body: Keep the new defaults in this PR only with explicit maintainer acceptance and exact-head proof covering deletion expectations, bounded disk pressure, archive eviction order, and upgrades.

recommendation.title: Split retention policy
recommendation.body: Preserve the currently shipped retention and disk-budget defaults in this PR, then review the keep-by-default cold-tier policy separately with focused upgrade evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: Authored the retention redesign and explicitly identified the default change as requiring design sign-off.
